name: DescribeRisks

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline.

You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to obtain the baseline ID
parameters.help_zh:
基线的ID。

您可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取基线ID
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of baselines to return. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回基线的数量限制。如果不设置，默认为20
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：  
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts in the resource folder.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
